naip-overviews.title: NAIP visualization COGs, overview files
naip-overviews.description: Reduced pictures made from the NAIP visualization COGs, for drawing a map before the quarter quads are worth reading: one file per state, year and UTM zone at 9.6 m, and one file of the country with the latest flight of each state on top. RGB JPEG Cloud-Optimized GeoTIFFs with a mask where there is no picture. NAIP imagery is in the public domain and USDA asks for credit; these files are not a USDA product.
